recommended_phases.delivery: Publish/verify the tested candidate with authorization, accept repairs #920-#928, clear #929, then sign off the already implemented #932/#935 additions. Reconcile scope handoffs and deferral without duplicate coding.
Finish Training Grounds, affordable retraining and supplementary item-access design; produce measured session/build examples and bounded follow-ups.

Deliver the new design in three subsequent batches: focused EV training; affordable retraining; named Finder/advanced/milestone rewards. These follow-ups do not yet exist and are not claimed implemented.
Finish Link Cord acquisition policy/source and authorized live acceptance; retain the published 14-map implementation.
Contextual evolution access through the existing engine.
Three-name nursery extension and real elapsed acceptance.
Soothe Bell field friendship modifier and useful evolution.
Mirror Herb teaching and concurrent move/custody protections.
Once-only nonstacking NPC prize support, last due to economy and persistence scope.
Final supported/source/deferred reconciliation and authorized release/player acceptance; close the tracker only with honest child status.

dependency_notes: #929 is the hard gate for additional feature implementation. #923 depends on already-closed #921; #925/#928 reuse its consumption boundary.
#952 design precedes its three proposed implementation batches; no training shops are planned.
#947/#948/#950/#949/#951 are independent after #929. Their listed order is a recommended delivery sequence, not invented hard dependencies.
Real elapsed nursery checks can overlap independent later work without clock manipulation.
Keep acquisition/source installation, logged-in acceptance, published code and deployment separate.
limits: Read-only issue/code/evidence audit; no issues changed or closed.
Retained resolution evidence is not a fresh exhaustive runtime regression or deployment check.
No live server or stock inspection was performed in this audit.
All 151 closed issues have retained resolution-report references. This is documentary verification, not a new exhaustive mechanics or live replay.
Scope records are closure-review candidates, not proof their generated runtime follow-ups work.
No GitHub state/body mutation, source edit, push, deployment, stock change or server operation is part of this audit.
The two unrelated untracked region-design documents are preserved.
